# PredictPro — AI Football Predictions & Analytics

PredictPro provides automated match predictions, mathematical expected goals (xG) metrics, Poisson probability models, head-to-head performance analysis, and live football data for 40+ leagues worldwide.

## Primary Sections & Links
- [Home & Daily Highlights](https://predictpro.guru/)
- [Live Matchday Scores](https://predictpro.guru/live)
- [League Standings & Tables](https://predictpro.guru/standings)
- [Mathematical Prediction Matrix](https://predictpro.guru/predict)
- [Performance & Historical Accuracy](https://predictpro.guru/performance)
- [Value Bets & Odds Analyzer](https://predictpro.guru/value-bets)
- [Community Tipsters & Leaderboards](https://predictpro.guru/leaderboard)

## Data Coverage
- Premier League (England)
- La Liga (Spain)
- Bundesliga (Germany)
- Serie A (Italy)
- Ligue 1 (France)
- UEFA Champions League & Europa League
- Kenya Premier League (FKF-PL)
- Over 40 global leagues with synchronized real-time match events.
